entries.title: Battle 0-1 | Blooper
entries.description: Final boss of the Prologue!

entries.title: Battle 1-1 | Gold Fuzzy
entries.description: Boss of the Shhwonk Fortress/Sewers!

entries.title: Battle 1-2 | Red Bones
entries.description: Mid boss of Hooktail Castle!

entries.title: Battle 1-3 | Hooktail (no FX, 10 HP)
entries.description: Final boss of Chapter 1 and Hooktail Castle! Completed without using the frog FX badge and with only 10 HP!

entries.title: Battle 1-4 | (Just) Gus
entries.description: Optional boss fight with Gus... Just Gus. He guards the entrance to east Rogueport.

entries.title: Battle 2-1 | The Three Shadows
entries.description: Mid boss fight of the Boggly Woods! And what a great triple knock-out!

entries.title: Battle 2-2 | Magnus von Grapple
entries.description: #nostalgia #bossfight (Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door)

entries.title: Battle 3-1 | Bowser (Glitz Pit)
entries.description: Surprise boss fight with the Koopa King Bowser! But what's he doing in Glitz Pit?

entries.title: Battle 3-2 | Rawk Hawk
entries.description: The champion title fight of the Glitz Pit! Honestly a very fun boss fight!

entries.title: Battle 3-3 | Macho Grubba
entries.description: Final boss of Chapter 3 and the Glitz Pit/Glitzville!

entries.title: Battle 4-1 | Atomic Boo
entries.description: Optional boss fight of the Creepy Steeple!

entries.title: Battle 4-2 | ?????
entries.description: The final(?) boss of the Creepy Steeple!

entries.title: Battle 4-3 | Doopliss
entries.description: The final boss of the Creepy Steeple! For real this time!

entries.title: Battle 5-1 | Cortez
entries.description: The final boss of Keelhaul Key! And my personal favourite in the game!

entries.title: Battle 5-2 | Lord Crump (Pirate Ship)
entries.description: The final (final) boss of chapter 5! Haven't seen this guy for a while!

entries.title: Battle 6-1 | Smorg
entries.description: The final boss of the Excess Express! And fought atop a speeding train!

entries.title: Battle 6-2 | Bonetail
entries.description: The final boss of the Pit of 100 Trials! The original superboss of the game!

entries.title: Battle 7-1 | Magnus Von Grapple 2.0
entries.description: The final boss of the Chapter 7! Crump's mech is much improved, so let's put it to the test!

entries.title: Battle 8-1 | Dark Bones
entries.description: The first of many chapter 8 bosses! Although this one seems a little familiar...

entries.title: Battle 8-2 | Gloomtail
entries.description: The third boss of the dragon trio! Not necessarily the order your supposed to fight them in, but this one certainly gave us the most trouble!

entries.title: Battle 8-3 | Two Shadows Plus Doopliss
entries.description: The Three Shadows make a return, but down one shadow and up one Doopliss!

entries.title: Battle 8-4 | Grodus
entries.description: The head honcho of the X-Nauts! This is our first official interaction, so let's put him in his place!

entries.title: Battle 8-5 | Bowser and Kammy Koopa
entries.description: Bowser returns in a very unexpected way! And Kammy is here too, so let's give them a good fight despite being a little tuckered out!

entries.title: Battle 8-6 | Shadow Queen
entries.description: The final boss of the game! Consisting of two distinct phases, this final fight is certaintly no pushover!

entries.title: Battle 8-7 | Whacka
entries.description: A secret boss exclusive to the remake! After getting pounded for the entire game, it's time for Whacka to get his revenge...

entries.title: Battle 8-8 | Prince Mush
entries.description: A secret boss exclusive to the remake! After saving him from what ever happened to him, Prince Mush returns with more fight than ever!
